guard: The chat stream's history limit: the provisioner may update the chat stream and no other message stream, `cotal up` moves only the legacy pair, a broker refusal of the update is not reported as an unknown outcome, recall reads the stream's own limits and its head, and durable catch-up tombstones only on the per-sender rule, reading the channel's oldest post through its own consumer.
why: The suite imports core from `src`, so no build is needed and each mutant is what the suite runs. Every cell
runs against a live broker, so a mutation is graded by the broker's own permission checks, expiry and stored
config. Each mutation reddens a different named cell.

mutations.name: the provisioner loses its chat stream update grant
mutations.expectRed: cotal up's setup, as the provisioner, moves a legacy chat stream to 30 days and 1000 per sender
mutations.cell: cotal up's setup, as the provisioner, moves a legacy chat stream to 30 days and 1000 per sender
mutations.note: Without the grant every authed space dies on a permissions violation at its first start on this release.

mutations.name: the grant is widened to the DM stream
mutations.expectRed: the provisioner may not update DM_
mutations.cell: the provisioner may not update DM_<space>

mutations.name: cotal up moves any limit, not only the legacy pair
mutations.find: if (!isLegacyChatHistory(chatHistoryLimitOf(config as unknown as Record<string, unknown>))) return undefined;
mutations.expectRed: cotal up leaves an operator's limit as it is
mutations.cell: cotal up leaves an operator's limit as it is
mutations.note: The mutant still migrates the legacy pair, so only the cell that runs setup over an operator's limit sees it overwritten.

mutations.name: a permission refusal of the update is reported as an unknown outcome
mutations.find: if (e instanceof JetStreamApiError || isPublishPermissionDenied(e)) throw e;
mutations.expectRed: a credential without the update grant is refused, not reported as an unknown outcome
mutations.cell: a credential without the update grant is refused, not reported as an unknown outcome

mutations.name: the head rule enters durable catch-up
mutations.find: const evicted = (await this.chatRetainedLoss(subject, fromSeqExcl, () => this.oldestRetainedThrough(name, subject))).capEvicted;
mutations.replace: const evicted = ((l) => l.capEvicted || l.headPassed)(await this.chatRetainedLoss(subject, fromSeqExcl, () => this.oldestRetainedThrough(name, subject)));
mutations.expectRed: a join whose window the stream head passed, with nothing of its channel removed, activates
mutations.cell: a join whose window the stream head passed, with nothing of its channel removed, activates
mutations.note: Another channel's removals would then tombstone a join that lost nothing.

mutations.name: the daemon reads the oldest post through the agent reader and swallows its failure, as before
mutations.find: const evicted = (await this.chatRetainedLoss(subject, fromSeqExcl, () => this.oldestRetainedThrough(name, subject))).capEvicted;
mutations.replace: const evicted = (await this.chatRetainedLoss(subject, fromSeqExcl, async () => (await this.collectHistory(subject, { seq: 1 }, { limit: 1 }).catch(() => []))[0]?.seq)).capEvicted;
mutations.expectRed: a join whose window lost a sender's posts to the per-sender count is refused as durable
mutations.cell: a join whose window lost a sender's posts to the per-sender count is refused as durable
mutations.note: The delivery daemon holds no lifecycleUid, so the agent reader refuses it; swallowed, the eviction is never seen and the join is reported complete.

mutations.name: recall ignores the stream head
mutations.find: return { messages: collected, seqs, dropped: loss.capEvicted || loss.headPassed, unanswered: false };
mutations.replace: return { messages: collected, seqs, dropped: loss.capEvicted, unanswered: false };
mutations.expectRed: recall reports a channel whose posts are all gone, with the stream head past the watermark
mutations.cell: recall reports a channel whose posts are all gone, with the stream head past the watermark

mutations.name: recall judges the count against the compiled 1000, not the stream's limit
mutations.expectRed: recall reports a channel where a sender passed the stream's per-sender count
mutations.cell: recall reports a channel where a sender passed the stream's per-sender count
